# terraform-provider-resend

Source: https://github.com/y0n0zawa/terraform-provider-resend/blob/main/README.md

# terraform-provider-resend

Terraform provider for managing [Resend](https://resend.com) resources such as domains and API keys.

## Requirements

- [Terraform](https://www.terraform.io/downloads.html) >= 1.0
- [Go](https://golang.org/doc/install) >= 1.24 (to build the provider)

## Usage

```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    resend = {
      source = "y0n0zawa/resend"
    }
  }
}

provider "resend" {
  api_key = var.resend_api_key # Or set RESEND_API_KEY environment variable
}
```

## Authentication

Set the API key via the provider block or the `RESEND_API_KEY` environment variable:

```bash
export RESEND_API_KEY="re_..."
```

## Resources and Data Sources

### Resources

- `resend_domain` - Manages a Resend domain
- `resend_api_key` - Manages a Resend API key
- `resend_domain_verification` - Triggers domain verification

### Data Sources

- `resend_domain` - Reads a Resend domain
- `resend_api_key` - Reads a Resend API key

## Example

```hcl
# Create a domain
resource "resend_domain" "example" {
  name   = "mail.example.com"
  region = "us-east-1"
}

# Verify the domain
resource "resend_domain_verification" "example" {
  domain_id = resend_domain.example.id
}
```

## Development

### Build

```bash
go build -o terraform-provider-resend
```

### Test

```bash
go test ./...
```

### Generate documentation

```bash
go generate ./...
```

# resend_api_key (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a Resend API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "resend_api_key" "example" {
  id = "key_123456"
}

output "api_key_name" {
  value = data.resend_api_key.example.name
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The API key ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the API key was created.
- `name` (String) The name of the API key.

# resend_domain (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a Resend domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "resend_domain" "example" {
  id = "d91cd9bd-1176-453e-8fc1-35364d380206"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The domain ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the domain was created.
- `name` (String) The domain name.
- `records` (Attributes List) DNS records required for domain verification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))
- `region` (String) The region where the domain is hosted.
- `status` (String) The verification status of the domain.

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
- `priority` (String)
- `record` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `ttl` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `value` (String)

# resend Provider

The Resend provider allows you to manage Resend resources such as domains and API keys.

## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The API key for authenticating with the Resend API. Can also be set with the `RESEND_API_KEY` environment variable.

# generated by https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-docs
page_title: "resend_api_key Resource - terraform-provider-resend"
  Manages a Resend API key.

# resend_api_key (Resource)

Manages a Resend API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "resend_api_key" "example" {
  name       = "production"
  permission = "full_access"
}

# API key restricted to a specific domain
resource "resend_api_key" "sending_only" {
  name       = "sending-only"
  permission = "sending_access"
  domain_id  = resend_domain.example.id
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the API key.

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) The domain ID to restrict the API key to.
- `permission` (String) The permission level. Valid values: `full_access`, `sending_access`. Defaults to `full_access`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The API key ID.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The API key token. Only available after creation; cannot be retrieved later.

# resend_domain (Resource)

Manages a Resend domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "resend_domain" "example" {
  name   = "mail.example.com"
  region = "us-east-1"

  open_tracking  = true
  click_tracking = true
  tls            = "enforced"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain name.

### Optional

- `click_tracking` (Boolean) Whether click tracking is enabled.
- `custom_return_path` (String) The custom return path for the domain.
- `open_tracking` (Boolean) Whether open tracking is enabled.
- `region` (String) The region where the domain is hosted. Valid values: `us-east-1`, `eu-west-1`, `sa-east-1`, `ap-northeast-1`. Defaults to `us-east-1`.
- `tls` (String) The TLS setting. Valid values: `enforced`, `opportunistic`. Defaults to `opportunistic`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the domain was created.
- `id` (String) The domain ID.
- `records` (Attributes List) DNS records required for domain verification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))
- `status` (String) The verification status of the domain.

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
- `priority` (String)
- `record` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `ttl` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `value` (String)

# generated by https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-docs
page_title: "resend_domain_verification Resource - terraform-provider-resend"
  Triggers verification for a Resend domain. Creating this resource sends a verification request to Resend. The domain's DNS records must be configured before verification can succeed.

# resend_domain_verification (Resource)

Triggers verification for a Resend domain. Creating this resource sends a verification request to Resend. The domain's DNS records must be configured before verification can succeed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "resend_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

resource "resend_domain_verification" "example" {
  domain_id = resend_domain.example.id
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain to verify.

### Read-Only

- `status` (String) The verification status of the domain after triggering verification.
